name: marimekko-chart
title: Marimekko chart
description: Stacked 100% bars whose widths also mean something: column width is group size, block height is mix. Columns grow up on scroll.
htmlExample:
<bef-marimekko-chart class="w-[36rem] max-w-full" :keys='[{"key":"pro","label":"Pro"},{"key":"biz","label":"Business","color":"text-success"},{"key":"starter","label":"Starter","color":"text-warning"}]' :columns='[{"label":"North","values":{"pro":40,"biz":30,"starter":10}},{"label":"West","values":{"pro":55,"biz":50,"starter":20}},{"label":"South","values":{"pro":30,"biz":20,"starter":25}},{"label":"East","values":{"pro":10,"biz":8,"starter":12}}]' id="g1"></bef-marimekko-chart>
<script type="module">
document.getElementById("g1").props = {
  format: (n) => `₹${n}L`,
};
</script>
